question: Where should the thirty-sixth kalā Kṣānti and the kalā Ramā be placed on the body?
premises: The thirty-sixth kalā is named Kṣānti.
Another kalā named Ramā is also to be placed.
The locations specified are the head and the arm.
inference: One should place the thirty-sixth kalā Kṣānti on the head and Ramā on the arm.
uncertainties: The ordinal position of Ramā is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: One should place the thirty-sixth kalā, Kṣānti, on the head, and Ramā on the arm.
